name: ui-consumes-sdk-module
description: UI consuming an SDK module: list the specific files in src/ui/tsconfig.app.json include (like ../core/wire.ts), never the whole ../client dir — config-file.ts imports node:fs and breaks the DOM-lib composite build. Keep the SDK module's transitive closure on src/core/* only (ndjson.ts types its envelope against core/wire.ts ErrorEnvelope, not client/types.ts).

content: Renames must update: (1) src/ui-tests which read page files by name string (capability-layer.test.ts, lifecycle-poll-fallback.test.ts, ready-plans-tab.test.ts, plot-surface-removed.test.ts), and (2) the noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity override in biome.jsonc, which is keyed by path. Component identifiers stay PascalCase; only filenames change.

title: UI revamp planned as pl-7e38: Direction C operator console
rationale: Shell-first in-place rebuild beats a greenfield second UI package (bundle ratchet and dead-code guards would fight a parallel tree) and beats a token reskin (Direction C changes the IA). Forward-chained DAG keeps independent pages dispatchable while component-reuse pairs stay sequential.

name: direction-c-token-wiring
description: Direction C theming (warren-059a): tokens.css holds the verbatim canvas :root (dark base + --color-lt-* twins, fonts given fallback stacks), a :root[data-theme=light] remap plus a prefers-color-scheme no-attribute fallback, a compat layer aliasing legacy names (--color-fg/--color-card/--color-muted-foreground/-foreground inks) onto Direction C base names, and a @theme inline block (self-referencing var() entries are safe in inline mode — utilities get the var(), :root stays the single runtime source). Existing pages use only -(--color-*) arbitrary utilities, so no named color utilities needed re-mapping.

name: direction-c-console-shell
description: Direction C console shell lives in src/ui/src/components/console/ (shell, sidebar, topbar, nav defs, useConsoleStats). Sidebar counts bind to shared list query keys (['runs'], ['projects'], ['agents']) so the lifecycle stream invalidation refreshes them; BURN/RUNTIME figures stay '—' placeholders until the ops overview API (warren-d850). Page stubs use ComingPage naming the building issue. Structural guards in src/ui-tests/capability-layer.test.ts read source files by path — update them when moving components (warren-4ed7).

name: direction-c-page-structure
description: Direction C page pattern: page state in a use-<page>-state.ts hook (queries + mutation + default autofill), pure derivations in a separate view-model module (dispatch/manifest-view.ts), thin page component under 200 lines. Keeps Biome cognitive-complexity ceiling (15) and the 500-line file budget happy. Guard tests in src/ui-tests/capability-layer.test.ts hard-code page component names and the GATED_ELSEWHERE mutation-site allowlist — a page rename must update them in the same PR.

name: direction-c-page-rebuild
description: Direction C page rebuild pattern (pl-7e38 page issues): self-pad the page like coming-page.tsx (px-6 pt-[22px] pb-12 sm:px-[24px]) since ConsoleShell's <main> has no padding; split table/formatting helpers into a pages/<page>/ sibling dir to hold the 500-line budget; keep query keys prefixed with the list name (['runs', ...]) so use-lifecycle-stream-invalidation keeps working; source-level structural tests in src/ui-tests/capability-layer.test.ts pin exact strings (e.g. 'total: runs.data?.costTotalUsd,' and useOperatorHint("Dispatch one above.")) — check those before changing page copy; re-baseline bundle ratchet with check:bundle-size --update (auto-raise cap covers ~6KB page growth).

name: ui-revamp-page-rebuild
description: Direction C page rebuild pattern (warren-e228): source-regex guards in src/ui-tests/capability-layer.test.ts pin exact JSX shapes of pages — when a page redesign renames a component (AddProjectForm -> AddProjectDialog) update the test regexes in the same change; keep OperatorOnly admin-wrapping of RefreshProjectsCTA literal to satisfy the caller-gated-leaf guard.

name: direction-c-page-translation
description: Direction C pages translate Paper exports (docs/ui-revamp/screens/*.jsx) into Tailwind arbitrary-value classes like text-(--color-text-3)/bg-(--color-primary) so both themes come from tokens.css; login page (warren-9297) is the reference for a rebuilt page, incl. gating spectator affordances on GET /instance authMode instead of guessing

name: instance-facts-page-binding
description: Direction C Instance page binds GET /instance via metaApi.instance; the spectator (public auth) response omits operator-only fields (dbBackend, uptimeSeconds, admission), so pages treat them optional and render quiet '—' placeholders. Instance wire types live in src/ui/src/api/instance-types.ts because api/types.ts is at its frozen 776-line size budget.

name: direction-c-page-layout
description: Direction C page pattern for src/ui: split page into pages/<name>.tsx + pages/<name>/ dir with a draft module (pure state/build-input), a state hook (queries + mutation), a form component split into per-section subcomponents (keeps Biome cognitive-complexity ≤15), and a manifest rail reusing ../dispatch/manifest-view.ts helpers (repositoryLabel, buildAdmissionRows). useMutation without OperatorOnly import must be allowlisted in src/ui-tests/capability-layer.test.ts GATED_ELSEWHERE when the mutation lives in a route-gated page state hook (see walk-state.ts, warren-02bb).

name: direction-c-page-directory
description: Direction C run detail (warren-8c85): each rebuilt page lives in pages/<name>/ as a directory (index.tsx composes, panels split to stay under the 500-line budget); biome.jsonc's noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity override list only shrinks, so new code must be decomposed into per-phase/per-panel helpers rather than added to the exception list. formatCostUsd is single-sourced in pages/run-detail-format.ts — import it there, never from a page module's re-export.

name: walk-inspector-detail-page
description: Plan-run detail pages (warren-2520) reuse the ["plan-runs", id] query key so the inventory's per-row detail fetch and the lifecycle stream invalidation share one cache entry; Direction C rail/panel components are plain bordered sections (41px header rows, token-variable colors) instead of shadcn Card wrappers.

name: ui-response-envelopes-in-client
description: warren-24b9: new UI response envelopes go in src/ui/src/api/client.ts (like the analytics types), because src/ui/src/api/types.ts is at its frozen 776-line check:size budget. Wire enums stay as core/wire re-exports in types.ts (EVENT_STREAMS/EventStream added there). UI helper modules exercised by bun test must import relatively — the @/ alias fails under the repo-root runner. Dense evidence-row pages: extract filter strip + rows panel into sub-components to stay under Biome's cognitive-complexity ceiling.

name: ops-overview-page-pattern
description: Operations page (pl-7e38 step 13, warren-d903): one GET /ops/overview poll feeds capacity/services/lifecycle/interventions; render operator-only sections on FIELD PRESENCE from the reduced public projection, never on capability guesses — absent !== zero (warren-f53e). Shared ["runs"] newest-runs window (limit 200) dedupes with the shell and gets lifecycle-stream invalidation for free; do NOT open a second /events/stream connection (one-per-tab rule, warren-f566) — the events panel is a quiet placeholder until warren-5eec. UI wire envelopes that would push a frozen-ceiling file over budget split into src/ui/src/api/<domain>-types.ts (ops-types.ts follows run-analytics-types.ts). Repo-root bun test resolves no @/ alias: type-only @/ imports are fine, runtime VALUE imports need relative paths (mx-2e4a1a).

name: extension-surface-fetch-outside-client
description: Direction C Telemetry consolidation (warren-7197): optional-extension HTTP surfaces (judge /verdicts.jsonl) are consumed by a plain fetch in a page-local hook (src/ui/src/pages/telemetry/judge-verdicts.tsx), NOT via src/ui/src/api/client.ts — check:client-contract fails any client.ts path the warren ROUTE_TABLE doesn't serve, and extension awareness must not leak into core. Absent/401/network states are normal conditions rendered as quiet panels, never error banners. Shared tab state across child routes belongs in the layout route (it stays mounted across Outlet switches), not URL search params (NavLink drops them).
